title: Vaccinated Travel Lane Arrangements with More Territories
what_it_is: Vaccinated Travel Lane Arrangements with More Territories

sections.label: VTL daily quota increase
sections.summary: The daily quota for all 13 VTL countries will rise to 4,000 when VTLs with Australia, Switzerland and the Republic of Korea commence.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: The quota for the first 10 VTL countries is 2,500.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: When the VTLs with Australia, Switzerland and the Republic of Korea commence later this month, the total daily quota for all 13 countries on the VTL scheme will be increased to 4,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: This is about 5% of the total daily arrivals at Changi pre-COVID-19.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: There will be about 19 daily VTL flights from these 13 countries, with an average VTL quota of 200 per flight.

sections.label: Written Answers and postponed Questions
sections.summary: Written Answers to listed Question Nos are reproduced in the Appendix, while other listed Question Nos are postponed to the 2 November 2021 sitting.
